name: Nike
notes: Revenue = Revenues. Nike reports no operating income line, so operatingIncome is derived for every year (quality estimated) as revenues less cost of sales and selling and administrative expense (FY2009 also less restructuring, goodwill and intangible impairment charges), which equals income before income taxes plus net interest and other (income) expense. FY ends May 31. Each year taken from the cited filing (as reported or as restated in that filing). Selling and administrative is split into demand creation and operating overhead from FY2010.
